title: 3EN Agent system inventory
description: Collect a basic Windows, PowerShell, network and disk inventory and save it to C:\3EN-Agent\system-inventory.txt.
backup: $Report='C:\3EN-Agent\system-inventory.txt'; if (Test-Path $Report) { Copy-Item $Report "$Report.bak" -Force; Write-Host "Previous report backed up to $Report.bak" } else { Write-Host 'No previous report to back up.' }
script: $Report='C:\3EN-Agent\system-inventory.txt'; $lines=@(); $lines += '=== 3EN AGENT SYSTEM INVENTORY ==='; $lines += "Generated: $(Get-Date -Format o)"; $lines += ''; $lines += '=== COMPUTER ==='; $lines += (Get-ComputerInfo | Select-Object CsName,WindowsProductName,WindowsVersion,OsArchitecture | Format-List | Out-String); $lines += '=== POWERSHELL ==='; $lines += ($PSVersionTable | Out-String); $lines += '=== IP ==='; $lines += (Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object {$_.IPAddress -notlike '169.254*'} | Select-Object InterfaceAlias,IPAddress,PrefixLength | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String); $lines += '=== DISKS ==='; $lines += (Get-Volume | Where-Object {$_.DriveLetter} | Select-Object DriveLetter,FileSystemLabel,FileSystem,SizeRemaining,Size | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String); $lines | Set-Content -Path $Report -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host "Inventory written to $Report"
test: $Report='C:\3EN-Agent\system-inventory.txt'; if (-not (Test-Path $Report)) { throw 'Inventory report was not created.' }; if ((Get-Item $Report).Length -lt 100) { throw 'Inventory report is unexpectedly small.' }; Get-Item $Report | Select-Object FullName,Length,LastWriteTime; Get-Content $Report -TotalCount 20
rollback: $Report='C:\3EN-Agent\system-inventory.txt'; if (Test-Path "$Report.bak") { Copy-Item "$Report.bak" $Report -Force; Write-Host 'Previous report restored.' } else { Remove-Item $Report -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'New report removed.' }
